versions.changelog:
- Updated metadata to include required configuration and environment variables under a new "requires" section.
- Removed explicit version field from metadata and adjusted the version number to "1.0.2".
- No code or functional changes; documentation and metadata update only.

- Added credential documentation specifying apiKey sourcing from config file and environment variables using ${ENV_VAR} placeholders.
- Introduced a security section outlining API key handling and best practices, including avoiding hardcoded secrets by using environment variables.
- Specified that API keys are only sent to configured provider endpoints and that no data is logged or shared with third parties.
- Updated metadata with author change (API_TKS → Polar) and included credentials and security fields.

Initial release of api-benchmark skill for measuring LLM API speed and connectivity.

- Benchmarks token generation speed across multiple LLM API providers.
- Measures TTFT (Time To First Token), tokens-per-second, and total generation time.
- Supports anthropic-messages, openai-completions, and openai-responses API formats.
- Reads provider configuration from ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json.
- Includes commands for listing targets, running benchmarks, preflight connectivity checks, and customizing runs.
